landing.badge: Your body. Your data. Your edge.
landing.heroDesc: A 6-step assessment learns your body. AI builds your meal plans and workout cycles. Your coach keeps you accountable. Every check-in makes it smarter.
landing.featuresDesc: A complete assessment maps your goals, body, schedule, diet, and medical history. Then the engine builds — and rebuilds — every cycle around you.
landing.feat1Desc: Full meal plans with exact macros, ingredients, step-by-step recipes, and meal alternatives. Built for your calories, your allergies, your preferences.
landing.feat2Desc: 14-day workout programs with sets, reps, rest periods, warmups, cooldowns, supersets, and cardio finishers. Each check-in recalibrates the next cycle.
landing.feat3Desc: AI generates the plans. Your coach reviews and fine-tunes them. Reach out anytime through the in-app ticket system — meals, workouts, or anything else.
landing.checkInTitle: Every data point rebuilds your plan.
landing.checkInDesc: Submit your weight, body measurements, progress photos, energy levels, sleep quality, and dietary adherence. Upload InBody scans or measure manually. The AI uses it all.
landing.coachAccessDesc: Direct support through in-app tickets. Meal issues, workout questions, progress concerns — your coach responds personally.
landing.progressTrackingDesc: Weight trend charts, measurement tracking, photo comparisons, daily meal and workout logging — your full history in one place.
landing.pricingDesc: Choose the plan that fits your ambition.
landing.compareDesc: See exactly what's included in each plan.
landing.plansComing: Pricing plans coming soon. Check back shortly.
landing.ctaDesc: Personalized meal plans. Adaptive workout cycles. A real coach in your corner. Join the athletes building their best bodies with FitFast.
landing.footerDesc: AI-powered meal plans, adaptive workout cycles, and dedicated coaching — personalized to your body, your goals, and your lifestyle.
landing.protocolSubtitle: We don't do guesswork. Every variable is measured, computed, and acted upon.
